title: WA UTC Docket 260540 — Order - Other: Order 01 Granting Less Than Statutory Notice.
summary: Order 01 Granting Less Than Statutory Notice.
text:
SPECIAL FUEL SURCHARGE SUPPLEMENT NO. 2026-03 
Applies on Carrier’s Tariff No. 3 

The Commission approves a temporary 1.63% fuel surcharge in all rates and 
charges as a result of increased fuel costs incurred by the company during the 
month of July 2026, to be collected from customers as a separate line item on 
the billing, as follows: 

Customers who are billed monthly for services in arrears: 

The fuel surcharge applies to all services provided in the month of July 2026.
